info.title: Project & Team Management API
info.description: REST API for projects, tasks, teams, comments and activity tracking. Click **Authorize** and log in with email + password to try protected endpoints.

post.description: Public self-registration. New accounts always get the **Team Member** role.
OAuth2 password flow: send `username` (your email) and `password` as form data.

patch.description: Activate or deactivate an account. Deactivated users can no longer log in or use existing tokens.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Roles Get

get.description: Admins see every project; everyone else sees projects they own or belong to.

schema.title: Response List Members Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Members Get
